author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: योगसंपूर्तिस्वरूपमाह ॥  यदेत्याद्यनेकश्लोकैः ।  यदा विशेषेण नियतं विषयेभ्यः प्रत्याहृतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते सर्वकामेभ्यः निस्पृहश्च यदा तदा युक्तो योगसंपूर्तिमानित्युच्यत इत्यर्थः ॥६.१८॥
translation:
When the mind completely restrained (from other objects) stands in Atman alone and when he ceases to thirst after all the desires, he is then said to be accomplished of Yoga.
V. In Atman alone: in the Lord alone.
A. When the practice of Yoga is complete, what is the state of the man?
